title: syngramma coriacea
intro: Syngramma coriacea, commonly known as the Leather Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae, native to tropical regions of Asia. The Leather Fern is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research has identified these bioactive compounds as responsible for the plant's anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
